decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of planning permission P/2024/0300 dated 20/03/2024.

Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: (SD2305(P)11. Received: 09/02/2026. SD2305(B)15-A. Received: 22/05/2026. SD2305(B)14-F. Received: 11/06/2026) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used. 

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans. 

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The hereby approved extension shall be used for Class E(e) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), nor in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
Reason: The Council is satisfied that the use hereby permitted would not result in detriment to adjoining properties but would wish to control future changes of use within the same Use Class to protect nearby land uses and the character of the area.

Condition : 5 - Customers shall only be permitted on the premises between 10:00 and 21:00 hours.

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions. 

Note:  If this approved use requires a trading licence from the Council (for example, because you intend to sell alcohol or offer entertainment) you should obtain this before you start to trade and note that the Licensing Panel will enquire about and wish you to disclose the terms of this permission and will likely align the terms of the licence with those set out here.  If your licence application seeks to exceed these hours, you will first need to have sought and obtained formally a variation to this condition by making a planning application.

Condition : 6 - Prior to commencement of the use hereby approved, evidence shall have been submitted to the local planning authority for approval in writing to demonstrate that the premises has been fitted out to a specified internal noise insulation level above that required by British Standard BS8233:2014 and/or its subsequent amendments, so as to provide sound insulation against sudden and underlying noise generated by the approved use which might affect residential units located above or to the sides of the site. The site shall be used in such a manner as to ensure that the noise insulation measures so approved are effective at all times.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the submitted details and prior to occupation, full details (including manufacturer's specifications) of the cycle stand for the staff of, the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before any part of the development is first occupied and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 8 - The approved refuse and recycling store as shown on approved plan no. [SD2305(B)14-F, received: 11/06/2026] shall be completed and made available for use before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, and thereafter shall be retained for such use at all times without obstruction. Bins shall be stored within the store at all times and shall not be left on the public highway. Reason: In order to ensure adequate provision for waste and recycling.
description: Variation of conditions 2 (Approved Plans) and 4 (Use Class) to allow the change of use of the approved extension to a Therapeutic Massage & Wellness Centre (Class E(e)) of planning permission P/2024/0300 approved 20/03/2024 for the Erection of first floor rear extension to rear of commercial unit at ground floor.
